name: bttd-monorepo
description: Webapp Quản lý Bê Tông Tây Đô - Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend1" "npm run dev:frontend2"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend-ke-toan && npm install && cd ../frontend-lanh-dao && npm install
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend1 && npm run build:frontend2
